minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  October 10, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, October 10,
2019, at 2:02 pm in the Community Room A, 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Debra Crenshaw, City Treasurer’s Office

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
September 26, 2019.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Raquel Wells DBA ICEF Inglewood Elementary School to host a Halloween
  Parade Carnival at 434 Grevillea Avenue, on Friday, October 25, 2019,
  from 9:00 a.m. - 3:30 p.m.; Church staff to provide security to maintain and
  manage crowd control throughout the duration of the event; Any person
  directing traffic is required to wear highly-visible retro-reflective vests; street
  closures are not permitted; parking lot is to be completely closed to
  vehicular traffic; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular
  circulation on/off site; and Adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage, local, state and
  federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00277195)

Item #2:  Christine M. Roberts DBA The Roberts Group to host SoFi Stadium Good
  Neighbor Plan Event at Darby Park, located at 3400 W. Arbor Vitae Street,
  on Saturday, October 26, 2019, from 11:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m.; Inglewood
  Police Department (IPD) staffing one (1) Sargent and four (4) Uniformed
  Officers; Stadium Security to provide extra security and IPD will provide
  extra patrol as time permits; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; any person directing
  traffic is required to wear highly-visible retro-reflective vests; no inflatable
 Permits & License Committee  October 10, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 2

  unites and bouncers are prohibited; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular
  circulation on/off site, no vehicles on walk; and Adhere to all applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage, local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity
  No. 00277146)

Tobacco Retailers License Renewal Request(s):

Item #3:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the following tobacco
  retailer businesses renewal with standard recommendations. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  Business Name  Business Type  Activity No.

 1  C & J 99 Cent Market  Convenient Store  00277111

Business License Renewal Request(s):

Item #4:  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following
  list of business license renewals, subject to payment of business tax;
  adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, state and federal law and standard
  business recommendation applicable to each business type. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  Business Name  Business Type  Activity No.

 1  Kings & Queens  Hair/Nail Shop  00249898

 2  Enterprise Rent-A-Car Company of LA LLC  Auto Rent  00249715

Public Comments
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any matters connected with items on the Agenda, it was
reported that there were no public requests to speak.

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:17 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
